title: Expanding an asset reveals its invoice detail rows with number link, date and per-invoice columns
refs: specs/sbc-sales-by-customer.md Story 8 S8-R4; S8-R12; S8-R12a; Story 20 S20-R14
custom_preconds: 1. You have expanded a customer and can see its asset rows.
custom_steps:
1. Click the chevron on an asset row.
2. Read the invoice detail rows that appear.
custom_expected:
1. The invoice detail rows for that asset appear, indented one level deeper than the asset row.
2. Each detail row shows the invoice number (as a link), the invoice date, and the per-invoice Inv. Hrs, Labor Invoiced, Labor Margin, Parts Invoiced, Parts Margin, Shop Supplies, Margin, Margin %, and Subtotal.
3. The invoice date shows in the format "Mon DD YYYY" — for example, May 14 2026.
